decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Location plan and E&P/006A received 07.03.11.E&P001D, E&P002D, E&P003D, PSP/004D and PSP/005D received 16.05.11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The window formed in the rear elevation shall be obscure glazed to a height of 1.7m above internal floor level and non-opening and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing. The windows above this height shall be hinged to open inwards.
description: Erection of a second storey rear roof extension to the upper floor flat.
